item.title: Trump claims Iran is exploring chemical, biological weapons
item.description:
Trump claims Iran is exploring chemical, biological weapons

US President Donald Trump claimed that Iran is seeking to look into chemical and biological weapons.

Trump said that Tehran was "looking at gases, looking at bio" during an interview with Fox News, without providing evidence to back his claims. 

The American president also said that while he does not believe Iran would launch a possible attack on Washington, he vowed that there would be retaliation if one occurred, saying: "If it does happen, we wipe them out."

Watch: Palestinians flee Gaza’s Nuseirat as Israeli army launches ground operation
item.description:
Watch: Palestinians flee Gaza’s Nuseirat as Israeli army launches ground operation

The Israeli military launched a new ground assault on residential areas in the central Gaza Strip on Wednesday, forcing displaced Palestinian families to flee despite the ceasefire agreement.
 
Tanks were seen advancing into areas near the Bureij and Nuseirat refugee camps, according to local media.
 
At least two people were wounded by indiscriminate fire near Nuseirat refugee camp, while scores of residents fled the area following the surprise assault.

Israeli tanks advanced near Gaza’s Bureij and Nuseirat refugee camps during a new ground assault on Wednesday, forcing Palestinian families to flee despite the ceasefire. At least two people were wounded, according to local reports. https://t.co/9QDMjEqApT

item.title: Saudi Arabia says danger in Wadi Al Dawasir, As Sulayyil passed after warning issued
item.description:
Saudi Arabia says danger in Wadi Al Dawasir, As Sulayyil passed after warning issued

Saudi Arabia’s civil defence said that danger in Wadi Al Dawasir and As Sulayyil governorates passed, shortly after it issued alerts over a potential threat. 

They urged residents to follow authorities instructions and avoid gathering and filming.

This brings the number of security alerts in the kingdom within the past few hours to a total of five.

item.title: UN warns over 18,000 Palestinians at risk of displacement amid Israeli offensive in Gaza
item.description: The UN on Wednesday warned that an Israeli military offensive in central Gaza could displace more than 18,000 Palestinians and disrupt essential humanitarian services, Anadolu reports. UN deputy spokesman Farhan Haq told reporters that the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported Palestinians fleeing the affected area in Deir al-Balah, moving west and southwest earlier Wednesday. “Initial analysis suggests that more than 18,000 people were staying in the affected area, which spans about 2.5 square kilometers (1 square mile). About 4,000 of them were staying in displacement sites,” he said. The warning followed the announcement of an Israeli military operation beyond the “yellow line” in Deir al-Balah. item.title: Israel’s change bloc says replacing Netanyahu is ‘highest priority’
item.description: Leaders of Israel’s change bloc said Wednesday that replacing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as soon as possible was their “highest priority” as efforts continued to form a new government, Anadolu reports. Gadi Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming the government, met with Yair Golan, Naftali Bennett, Avigdor Lieberman and Yair Lapid to review progress in coalition negotiations, Israel’s Channel 12 reported, citing a joint statement. “All party leaders agree that their highest priority is to form a national emergency government led by Gadi Eisenkot and to replace Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister as soon as possible,” the statement said. The leaders also discussed their use of a parliamentary majority in the Knesset, citing the election of lawmaker Matan […]

item.title: Syria remains ‘committed’ to security understanding with Israel, revival of 1974 disengagement deal: Foreign minister
item.description: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said Wednesday that Damascus is “committed” to reaching a security understanding with Israel and reactivating the 1974 Disengagement Agreement amid continued Israeli attacks and incursions into Syrian territory, according to the Alikhbaria state broadcaster, Anadolu reports. Shaibani spoke at a closed session on the sidelines of the Schuman Security and Defence Forum in Brussels, where he said Syria “remains committed to reaching a security understanding with Israel, reactivating the 1974 disengagement agreement and deploying the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) to maintain stability.” He said Syria had been subjected to more than 1,000 Israeli airstrikes since the fall of Bashar al-Assad’s regime in December 2024. Shaibani said Israel had occupied additional territory in southern Syria […]

Somalia, UAE trade words as defense minister accuses Abu Dhabi of ‘profiting from tragedies of peoples’
item.description: Somali Defence Minister Ahmed Moalim Fiqi accused the United Arab Emirates on Wednesday of fueling conflicts, buying loyalties and undermining the sovereignty of other nations, Anadolu reports. Fiqi said Abu Dhabi’s “malicious and destructive ideas have inspired your state’s policies of fueling wars.” “Your money will not buy our will, nor will it break our unity. Stop profiting from the tragedies of peoples, and do not build your prosperity on the ruins of their homelands. The blood of innocents is not a commodity to be traded,” he said in response to the UAE president’s senior diplomatic adviser Anwar Gargash.
